trello.name: Set Up Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Create three subscription tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) in Stripe with the specified pricing. Ensure these tiers are integrated into the app and their functionality mirrors the intended user experience.

trello.name: Design and Integrate Checkout Form with Stripe Elements
trello.desc: Develop a checkout form using Stripe Elements that aligns with the app's design. Ensure it handles errors like invalid card details gracefully and includes a clear comparison of features for each tier.

trello.name: Update Pricing Page
trello.desc: Revise the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers with clear details about what each plan offers. Ensure users can easily compare features and pricing.

trello.name: Develop User Dashboard Functionalities
trello.desc: Implement dashboard features to display current plan details, billing info, and options for upgrading, downgrading, or canceling subscriptions. Include access to invoices and payment history, and allow users to update payment methods.

trello.name: Backend Integration with Stripe API
trello.desc: Integrate Stripe API to manage subscriptions, process payments, and handle webhooks for events such as invoice payment success or failure, and subscription cancellations.

trello.name: Set Up Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Develop handlers for specific Stripe webhook events like invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Test thoroughly to ensure system updates correctly based on these events.

trello.name: Testing and Quality Assurance
trello.desc: Prepare and execute a detailed test plan covering both manual and automated tests. Test the complete subscription flow, including edge cases, to ensure functionality and user experience are as expected.

trello.name: User Documentation and Support
trello.desc: Create user documentation and a help section or FAQ that provides clear instructions on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and troubleshooting common issues.

trello.name: Document API Endpoints and Webhook Handlers
trello.desc: Document the API endpoints and webhook event handlers for easier maintenance and troubleshooting in the future.

trello.name: Coordinate Follow-Up Meeting
trello.desc: Plan a follow-up meeting next week to review progress, address issues, and synchronize frontend and backend development efforts.
